[![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/DevUtilsApp/DevUtils-app) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/devutils-app/id1533756032?platform=mac)

summary.name: DevUtils
summary.one_liner: DevUtils is a native macOS toolbox of 47+ offline developer utilities for formatting, converting, encoding, hashing and debugging everyday data.
use_cases: convert between JSON, YAML, CSV and query strings
decode Base64 or URL-encoded strings offline
generate UUIDs, hashes or QR codes
debug JWTs and test regular expressions
compare text with a diff checker
summary.what_it_does: DevUtils is a native macOS app that bundles 47+ developer tools. It detects the right tool automatically from clipboard content, for example recognizing a Unix timestamp, JSON or Base64 string. It covers generation tasks such as QR codes, Lorem Ipsum, UUID, Nano ID and MD5/SHA1/SHA2 hashes, plus encoding and decoding of URLs, Base64 and HTML entities. It also converts between data formats such as YAML to JSON, JSON to CSV and HTML to JSX, and includes debugging tools like a JWT debugger, RegExp tester, HTML preview and text diff checker. The page says it works entirely offline, so pasted data stays on the machine.
notable: Works entirely offline; pasted data never leaves the machine
Auto-detects the right tool from clipboard content
Integrates with Terminal, Alfred and Raycast
caveats: Listed as Freeware on awesome-mac; the page does not describe paid tiers
